changes: One file traversal computes both all-pairing storage and owner workspace totals. Reservations, free-space checks and authority checks remain fresh.
Window package identity reads do not prefetch descendants. Runtime authorization is not cached or relaxed.
Hex encoding avoids repeated formatting without changing grant or revoke identity bytes.
ping exposes only the current claim latest file command duration/count metadata; no path, payload or transfer identity.

checks.source_distribution_preflight: Passed after correcting the result JSON allowlist kind; 303 required files, no missing files or heuristic scan findings.

synthetic_profile.scope: Same host Java fixture of 24 workspace files and one upload; not phone latency.

second_upload.deviation: Started before the original upload had finished, contrary to the planned ordering. Both original IDs and inputs retained privately; no further blind retries.

device_acceptance.metric_limit: These last-file metrics have no request sequence or ID. They may describe the preceding successful chunk; they do not establish the duration of the timed-out chunk. Each first ping after a 504 failed with task_status_required. Do not subtract unrelated file timings from CLI round trips.
device_acceptance.evidence_type: Transcribed original Muse conversation receipt; private full logs are held by Muse. No fabricated local raw-log capture.

privacy: Synthetic metadata only; no private phone content, identities, credentials or endpoints.

emulator_upgrade.scope: Upgrade/runtime smoke check only; no real-phone or upload-performance acceptance.

follow_up.network_route_difference: VPN versus per-app bypass is an unverified hypothesis, not an established cause. A bounded same-transfer route test was sent on 2026-11-12.
follow_up.focused_grok_review: No usable result from two real Grok dispatches: original and bounded shorter retry both ended with idle timeout (exit 124). Earlier completed general capability review remains separate.
